text:
Maya K.: Heads up — onboarding venus-v2 (13B) to Triton on the dev cluster. Weights are in s3://redwood-models/venus-v2/2026-03-15/ — container fails to start with CUDA/Triton mismatch. Anyone seen this before?
Samir P.: @Maya K. can you paste the exact error output?
Maya K.: sure, paste from pod logs: ```tritonserver: ERROR: libcuda.so.1: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory
[triton] Kernel selection failed: incompatible CUDA runtime (11.8) vs container (12.2)```
Joel R.: That screams image/runtime mismatch. Our dev nodes currently have driver CUDA 11.8. Which base image did you use — `redwood/triton:latest`?
Maya K.: yes used latest because the model README pointed at the latest-triton example. The model also includes a custom op compiled locally (custom_op.so) with TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=8.0.
Laura T.: Two probable issues: (1) the custom op binary likely built against CUDA 12 toolchain, so it links `libcudart.so.12`. (2) Triton container/runtime expects different CUDA major. Quick check: run `ldd` on the .so inside the same base image.
Laura T.: Example command: `docker run --rm -it -v /tmp/model:/model redwood/triton:cuda11.8 bash -c "ldd /model/custom_op.so"`
Maya K.: ran that on a local rebuild — shows `libcudart.so.12 => /usr/local/cuda-12/lib64/libcudart.so.12` so it's definitely built against CUDA12.
Ricardo G.: Short fix: rebuild the custom op with our builder image `redwood/build:cuda11.8` and push the artifact. Longer term: add a model manifest field `builder_cuda: "11.8"` so folks don't assume `latest` matches cluster drivers.
Samir P.: is `builder_cuda` a new manifest key? We'll need to add validation in model onboarding to warn/fail when it doesn't match the node driver.
Joel R.: Also validate the Triton backend args — not likely the cause but check `nvidia-smi` inside the runtime to confirm driver version. If the container tries to load cuda12 libs but host driver is 11.8, it will fail.
infrastructure-bot: [deploy-check] node gpu driver: 470.129.06 (CUDA 11.8 ABI), supported container runtimes on cluster: 11.7-11.8. Detected mismatch with container: 12.x — aborting auto-deploy.
Maya K.: thanks — rebuilding the op with `redwood/build:cuda11.8` now, ETA ~30m. Pushing a note to the model repo. Also ran unit tests and saw tokenizer failures — looks like a BOS id mismatch.
Maya K.: tokenizer quirk: vocab defines `<s>` at id 0 but our runtime/eval harness expects `bos_token_id=1`. Tests that assert prompt formatting are failing.
Laura T.: For tokenizers we usually add a local override in the model config. Example: `tokenizer_override: {"bos_token_id": 0, "eos_token_id": 2}` — add that to model repository and CI. Also add a tiny generation smoke test.
Ricardo G.: I'll add a CI lint that compares `model_config.tokenizer.bos_token_id` to `vocab.json` index for `<s>` and raise an error if inconsistent.
Samir P.: let's also make the loader emit a clear warning when `builder_cuda` != host cuda or the custom op links to an unexpected libcudart. That should save a lot of handholding.
Joel R.: +1. Also add a smoke check in the image build pipeline that runs `python -c "from transformers import AutoTokenizer; AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('/model'); print('tok-ok')"` and a tiny `generate` with `max_new_tokens=8`. Fail the image if it errors.
Maya K.: rebuilding and retesting now. Will update thread with push + CI PR. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: 
infrastructure-bot: [ci] build/redwood-models/venus-v2/op-rebuild #378 — SUCCESS (12m) — image pushed to registry `ghcr.io/redwood/venus-v2:cuda11.8-opfix`
Maya K.: deployed new image in dev — container starts clean, Triton picks correct kernels. Tokenizer override applied and tests pass locally. Will open PR for manifest + CI checks in 10m.
Ricardo G.: great — after PR merges we should backfill the manifest template and add a note in the onboarding doc about `builder_cuda` and tokenizer overrides.
Samir P.: nice work. leaving a small follow-up issue to add automated kernel/runtime compatibility validation in the model validator.
Maya K.: thanks all, closing the loop here. If anyone needs the rebuild artifacts the s3 prefix is s3://redwood-models/venus-v2/2026-03-15/opfix/
Joel R.: Nice. :party_parrot:
